pane.en: A cracked pane was replaced before the classroom reopened.
pane.zh: 教室重新開放前，破裂的窗玻璃被更換了。

panorama.en: The observation deck offers a panorama of the entire valley.
panorama.zh: 觀景台可以看到整個山谷的全景。

papa.en: The child called for papa when the train arrived.
papa.zh: 火車抵達時，那個孩子呼喊爸爸。

paradoxically.en: Paradoxically, adding more choices sometimes makes decisions harder.
paradoxically.zh: 矛盾的是，增加更多選擇有時反而讓決定更困難。

paragon.en: The biography presents her as a paragon of patience and discipline.
paragon.zh: 這本傳記把她描寫成耐心與自律的典範。

paramount.en: Student safety remains paramount during every school activity.
paramount.zh: 在每一項學校活動中，學生安全始終最重要。

pawn.en: He moved one pawn forward at the start of the chess game.
pawn.zh: 棋局開始時，他把一枚兵向前移動。

pawnshop.en: The old pawnshop was converted into a small bookstore.
pawnshop.zh: 那間舊當鋪被改建成一家小書店。

payday.en: The article explains how families plan expenses around payday.
payday.zh: 文章說明家庭如何依照發薪日安排支出。

penetrating.en: A penetrating question led the class to examine the issue more carefully.
penetrating.zh: 一個深入的問題讓全班更仔細檢視這個議題。

pentagon.en: The geometry worksheet asks students to draw a regular pentagon.
pentagon.zh: 幾何作業要求學生畫一個正五邊形。

periodic.en: The machine requires periodic checks to remain in good condition.
periodic.zh: 這台機器需要定期檢查才能維持良好狀態。

periodical.en: The library keeps each science periodical in a separate section.
periodical.zh: 圖書館把每本科學期刊放在獨立區域。

perpetual.en: The story imagines a city trapped in perpetual winter.
perpetual.zh: 故事想像一座被困在永恆冬季中的城市。

perplex.en: The unusual result continued to perplex the research team.
perplex.zh: 這個不尋常的結果持續讓研究團隊感到困惑。

perseverance.en: Her perseverance helped her finish the difficult research project.
perseverance.zh: 她的毅力幫助她完成困難的研究專題。

pertain.en: These rules pertain only to students using the laboratory.
pertain.zh: 這些規定只適用於使用實驗室的學生。

philharmonic.en: The class attended a philharmonic concert during its music unit.
philharmonic.zh: 班級在音樂單元期間參加了一場管弦樂團音樂會。

physiological.en: The lesson covers physiological changes that occur during exercise.
physiological.zh: 課程介紹運動期間會出現的生理變化。

picket.en: A small picket fence surrounds the school garden.
picket.zh: 學校花園周圍有一圈小木柵欄。

pick-up.en: The school changed the afternoon pick-up area near the main gate.
pick-up.zh: 學校調整了大門附近的下午接送區。

picturesque.en: The train passed through a picturesque village beside the lake.
picturesque.zh: 火車經過一座湖邊風景如畫的村莊。

piety.en: The history text discusses piety in the context of ancient culture.
piety.zh: 歷史課文在古代文化脈絡中討論虔敬。

pigment.en: The art teacher explained how pigment affects the color of paint.
pigment.zh: 美術老師說明顏料色素如何影響油漆顏色。

pilgrimage.en: The documentary follows a historical pilgrimage across several regions.
pilgrimage.zh: 紀錄片追蹤一趟跨越多個地區的歷史朝聖旅程。

ping-pong.en: Students played ping-pong in the recreation room after class.
ping-pong.zh: 學生下課後在休閒室打桌球。

pious.en: The novel portrays a pious character devoted to community service.
pious.zh: 小說描寫一位虔誠且投入社區服務的角色。

piston.en: The diagram shows how a piston moves inside an engine.
piston.zh: 圖示顯示活塞如何在引擎內移動。

plainly.en: The instructions plainly state when the report is due.
plainly.zh: 說明中清楚寫明報告的繳交時間。

planetary.en: The science club built a planetary model for the exhibition.
planetary.zh: 科學社為展覽製作了一個行星模型。

planning.en: Careful planning helped the team finish before the deadline.
planning.zh: 仔細規劃幫助團隊在期限前完成工作。

plaster.en: Workers repaired the wall with fresh plaster before painting it.
plaster.zh: 工人在粉刷前先用新灰泥修補牆面。

plato.en: The philosophy class discussed an idea associated with plato.
plato.zh: 哲學課討論一個與柏拉圖相關的思想。

playmate.en: The child met a new playmate at the neighborhood park.
playmate.zh: 那個孩子在社區公園認識了一位新玩伴。

pleased.en: The teacher was pleased with the group's clear presentation.
pleased.zh: 老師對小組清楚的簡報感到滿意。

pollutant.en: The report identifies smoke as a major air pollutant in the area.
pollutant.zh: 報告指出煙霧是該地區主要空氣污染物之一。

polynomial.en: The worksheet asks students to simplify each polynomial carefully.
polynomial.zh: 作業要求學生仔細化簡每一個多項式。

postman.en: The postman delivered a package to the school office.
postman.zh: 郵差把包裹送到學校辦公室。

post-war.en: The museum focuses on post-war changes in housing and transportation.
post-war.zh: 博物館著重介紹戰後住宅與交通的變化。

potentiality.en: The teacher encouraged us to consider the potentiality of the new design.
potentiality.zh: 老師鼓勵我們思考這項新設計的潛力。
